snippet.title: Official UK PlayStation Magazine - Net Yaroze - Bouncer II
snippet.description:
This is a video of the Net Yaroze game Bouncer II, created by Scott Evans.

It was featured on Official UK PlayStation Magazine's demo disc 12 volume 2 as a full game.

In the video I access the menu before attempting the first level of the game.
